message.elevators_escalators.height_lock: Already assembled. Rebuild the controller to change travel.
message.elevators_escalators.unavailable: Platform unavailable or unloaded. Wait for chunks to load.
message.elevators_escalators.blocked: Shaft blocked, too high, or unloaded. Clear a 3x3 shaft plus headroom.
message.elevators_escalators.assembled: 3x3 platform assembled. Use platform/controller to travel; use remote on controller to bind.
message.elevators_escalators.up: Target: upper stop; pauses if blocked or chunks unloaded.
message.elevators_escalators.down: Target: lower stop; pauses if blocked or chunks unloaded.
message.elevators_escalators.bound: Bound. Use in air for lower stop; sneak-use for upper stop.
message.elevators_escalators.bind_first: Bind to a controller in this dimension first.
message.elevators_escalators.floor_inval: Floor must be in travel range (16 stops max); register before calling.
message.elevators_escalators.floor_selec: Selected offset +%s; use in air to travel.
message.elevators_escalators.bound_multi: Bound. Use to open controls; sneak-use reference block to register floors.
screen.elevators_escalators.title: Elevator Control
